contribution_requirements: Functional components, named exports. No inline styles — Tailwind classes only. All types in src/types/lms.ts. Use db from @/lib/firebase, useAuth from @/contexts/AuthContext. Match existing patterns exactly. Do not touch auth, chat, news, opportunities, or documents features.
key_patterns: Pages: default export, import MobileTopBar from @/components/mobile/MobileTopBar for mobile header. Services: pure async functions importing db from @/lib/firebase, using Firestore SDK (collection, doc, getDoc, getDocs, setDoc, query, where, orderBy). Admin HOC: requireAdmin() from @/utils/adminAuth wraps admin pages. Tab routes added to APP_ROUTES array in App.tsx and to the `tabs` array in MobileTabBar.tsx. TITLE_MAP for page titles. Lazy imports for pages. Tailwind custom tokens: alu-gold (#D4AF37), alu-gold-strong (#B8941F), alu-gold-soft (#FBF7E9), alu-gold-border (#E8DDB0), alu-ink (#1A1A1A). shadcn components: @/components/ui/{button,card,badge,dialog,progress,accordion,select,sheet,input,label,tabs,avatar,separator}. Toast: `import { toast } from 'sonner'`. react-query: useQuery/useMutation from @tanstack/react-query.
directory_structure: src/pages/ — page components (lazy-loaded); src/pages/admin/ — admin-only pages (requireAdmin HOC); src/pages/courses/ — NEW LMS pages; src/components/ — reusable UI; src/components/mobile/ — mobile top/tab bars; src/components/ui/ — shadcn primitives; src/components/lms/ — NEW LMS components; src/services/ — Firestore service modules; src/types/ — TypeScript interfaces; src/lib/firebase.ts — exports db, auth; src/contexts/AuthContext.tsx — exports useAuth
